Low Stress handling and CC during all kitten and adult visits recommended.
Fearful and/or aggressive behavior negatively impacts frequency and level of veterinary care.
Effective implementation of Fear Free, Low Stress, and Cat Friendly visits reduces fear, anxiety, and stress and improves frequency and quality of veterinary care.
Fearful/fractious cats in veterinary setting often have comorbid behavioral problems at home,
such as aggression to owners or strangers, undesirable elimination, and anxiety disorders.
Socialization period (2–7 weeks)—time where positive early exposure minimizes fear.
Regular, gentle, brief exposure to handling paired with positive experience (food) leads to less fear/improved future handling.
